glyph.isekai_mahou.fire_afterburn.desc: Fire augment. Every target hit keeps a lodged ember: 2 s later it DETONATES for 50% of the damage dealt and applies Burning I. One ember per target at a time (extra copies don't stack).
glyph.isekai_mahou.water_undertow.desc: Water augment. On hit the wave pulls back and DRAGS the target toward you (bosses barely move) and makes it Wet. If it was already Wet, the cold water also applies Chilled I.
glyph.isekai_mahou.earth_aftershock.desc: Earth augment. 1 s after a hit the ground around the target quakes (radius 3.5): enemies STANDING on the ground take 35% of the damage and Stiffening I. Airborne enemies dodge it.
glyph.isekai_mahou.wind_ricochet.desc: Wind augment. The spell rides the wind: after a hit its effects jump to the nearest enemy AHEAD, in the direction it was travelling (up to 10 blocks), at 70% power with a push along the gust. 2 bounces per copy.
glyph.isekai_mahou.light_refraction.desc: Light augment. 25% of the damage dealt refracts into healing, split between the 2 most wounded allies within 10 blocks of the target (you count).
glyph.isekai_mahou.shadow_ambush.desc: Shadow augment. Against UNAWARE targets (back turned to you, not targeting you, or while you're invisible) damage is ×1.5. Against those facing you, applies Corrupted I.
glyph.isekai_mahou.arcane_mimic.desc: Arcane augment. On hit the spell COPIES the effects of your previous spell (the last one cast within 30 s, without Mimicry) and also applies them to the target at 40% power.
glyph.isekai_mahou.trigger_on_ignite.des: Fire TRIGGER (start of the recipe). The slot fires ON ITS OWN, aimed at the target, when an enemy starts Burning because of you. Pressing the slot key does not cast it; it pays mana and respects cooldown and Silence.
glyph.isekai_mahou.trigger_on_wet.desc: Water TRIGGER. The slot fires ON ITS OWN when YOU get Wet (rain, water, spells) or when an enemy gets Wet because of you (then it aims at it). Pressing the slot key does not cast it; it pays mana and respects cooldown and Silence.
glyph.isekai_mahou.trigger_on_landing.de: Earth TRIGGER. The slot fires ON ITS OWN when you land after falling 4 or more blocks — great for a ground slam. Pressing the slot key does not cast it; it pays mana and respects cooldown and Silence.
glyph.isekai_mahou.trigger_on_momentum.d: Wind TRIGGER. The slot fires ON ITS OWN after 3 s of non-stop sprinting (once per run: stop sprinting to re-arm). Pressing the slot key does not cast it; it pays mana and respects cooldown and Silence.
Light TRIGGER. The slot fires ON ITS OWN when one of your healing/support spells heals an ALLY (not you) within 32 blocks. Pressing the slot key does not cast it; it pays mana and respects cooldown and Silence.
glyph.isekai_mahou.trigger_in_shadows.de: Shadow TRIGGER. The slot fires ON ITS OWN when you step into darkness (light 4 or less) or turn invisible, aimed at the nearest visible enemy. Pressing the slot key does not cast it; it pays mana and respects cooldown and Silence.
glyph.isekai_mahou.trigger_resonance.des: Arcane TRIGGER. Every 4 spells you cast, the slot fires ON ITS OWN alongside, like an echo of your mana. Pressing the slot key does not cast it; it pays mana and respects cooldown and Silence.
glyph.isekai_mahou.earth_flatten.desc: Earth effect (building). Makes the ground FLAT at your feet's height: cuts hills, trees and brush above and fills holes and water below with the local ground (dirt with grass; sand in deserts). Self: around you; Projectile/Touch: where it hits. Radius 4 (Expand and power increase it; cap 6 + 2×Circle, max 24). No materials and no drops; costs +0.15 mana per column (radius 8 ≈ 30). The work proceeds gradually and respects protections.
message.isekai_mahou.glyphs_elements_a.r: This spell is reactive (%s): it fires on its own when the trigger happens.
message.isekai_mahou.glyphs_elements_a.f: Not enough mana to flatten the terrain.
